module_summary: PS/2 decoder: instantiates FSM and shift register to decode keyboard input stream into byte sequence.

anchors.name: tk
anchors.why: 4-bit tag output from FSM indicating frame state; bit[3] signals completion.

anchors.name: sh
anchors.why: 24-bit output window from shift register accumulating bytes.

anchors.name: hdr_bit
anchors.why: Marker bit extracted from input; steers FSM frame validation.

anchors.name: done
anchors.why: Output valid signal set when FSM tag[3] asserts (frame complete).

anchors.name: out_bytes
anchors.why: 24-bit decoded output passed when done signal asserts.

anchors.name: in
anchors.why: 8-bit input window; bit[3] used as frame marker.

groups.name: Frame Detection
groups.description: Extracts marker bit and sequences FSM through frame stages.

groups.name: Shift Register
groups.description: Accumulates incoming bits into 24-bit output window.
